title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - evidence & vendor follow-ups
content:
Quick brain dump for SOC2 work - personal scratchpad. Mostly TODOs and notes to self.

=== Today (2025-11-12) ===
- Morning: sync with Priya on evidence backlog (10:30). Ask for updated export of access logs for staging cluster (S3 path + retention notes).
- Follow-ups: vendor questionnaire from PineSec - missing A.3 doc and encryption diagram. Add to vendor-review queue.
- Pull list of service accounts created in last 90 days (need to match with audit log). Ticket pinned in SEC-472.

=== Evidence checklist (high level) ===
- Access control: IAM role list + justification -> have CSV from infra (ask Jordan for latest).
- Change management: PR list + approvals -> need PR links for Oct-Nov rollouts. Search GH: repo=infra-config label=security.
- Backups: backup schedule confirmation + restore test notes -> check Confluence backup runbook (CON-1234).
- Logging: S3 access logs + retention policy doc -> missing proof of retention for logs older than 180 days.
- Vendor mgmt: PineSec questionnaire, SSO proof for LogiCorp, DPA signed by Legal for DataSync Inc.

=== Vendor review TODOs ===
- PineSec: Email sent 2025-11-10, no response. Need to escalate to account manager (contact: maya@pinesec). Request: encryption architecture diagram + SOC2 type II report (redacted).
- LogiCorp: Confirm SSO IdP metadata exchange happened (ok in ticket). Capture screenshot from Okta admin console.
- DataSync Inc: DPA signed but no evidence of data deletion policy. Ask Legal to provide archive of signed DPA (ref: LGL-DS-2025).

=== Policy TODOs / drafts ===
- Draft: Data retention policy v2 -> incorporate input from privacy team. Open questions: retention buckets (90/365/forever), justification for 365 for telemetry.
- Draft: Vendor on-boarding checklist -> add "request of SOC2 report or equivalent" as hard requirement for high-risk vendors.
- Action: schedule 30-min review with Privacy (Anika) next week.

=== Short-term action list (sorted) ===
1) Ask Jordan for service account CSV (due 2025-11-13).
2) Escalate PineSec (email + CC Maya) (due 2025-11-14).
3) Grab Okta screenshot for LogiCorp SSO (due 2025-11-13).
4) Compile PR list for change mgmt (search GH + link to PRs) (due 2025-11-15).
5) Add retention proof for S3 logs older than 180 days (investigate lifecycle rules) (due 2025-11-18).

Notes to self / quick fragments:
- Still need a consistent naming convention for evidence files (e.g., evidence/ACCESS-control/2025-11-). Suggest: team-doctype-YYYYMMDD.
- Could automate vendor questionnaire follow-ups via a simple Gmail template + tracker sheet (low effort).
- Reminder: include timestamped exports (ISO8601) in all evidence PDFs.
- Check SMB/Shared drive access: who can see evidence folder? Limit to sec+legal for now.

Unresolved questions:
- Do we accept ISO27001 certificate in lieu of SOC2 for medium-risk vendors? (ask Priya + Legal).
- Who owns the final archive step for retired evidence (delete vs retain)? Proposal: Security retains 3 years then handoff to Records.

Links / refs:
- Confluence: Evidence inventory (CON-1234) -> need to sync with actual files in Drive.
- Jira: SEC-472 (service-account audit).
- Slack thread: #sec-soc2 (search for PineSec thread, 2025-11-10).

Meeting notes (11/11 retro with team):
- Good: progress on change-mgmt PRs and backup tests.
- Bad: vendor turnaround time slow. Need playbook for escalation.
- Idea: set SLA for vendor evidence turnaround (e.g., 10 business days) -> include in vendor onboarding checklist.

Tiny TODOs (one-line):
- [ ] Add evidence naming convention to Confluence.
- [ ] Create Gmail follow-up template.
- [ ] Drop PineSec contact in #sec-soc2.
- [ ] Save Okta screenshot to evidence/SSO/

End of scratchpad. Keep this doc informal. Will clean up and move finalized items to Confluence and Jira tickets.
